knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Measuring the real hours first, then choosing one response, addresses the shortfall. More bookings or skipping records make the gap worse.
A shared reference lets any job be traced across all its records. The other options do not follow from a shared number.
Fixed blocks group similar tasks and reduce switching. The other options spread admin through the day or push it into unsustainable hours.

practicalCriteria: Learner produces an admin time estimate listing each task with a measured or sourced time and a weekly total.
Learner compares the weekly total with the available hours and records the shortfall or surplus.
Learner sets up a booking list, quote register, invoice register and receipt folder, and shows the shared reference number on a sample job.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Admin time estimate with measured examples
Sample job traced across quote, job sheet, invoice and receipt
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Create a booking list, a quote register, an invoice register and a receipt folder, each linked by one reference number.
